description: Who every external or off-box agent is, how Summer reaches it, what it is for, and whether its terms allow automated use. Static facts only: runtime state (current assignment, last heartbeat, busy-time share) is derived by Summer from the mesh heartbeat and the dispatch ledger and is never hand-edited here. Joins by id: agents[].identityId -> canon/agent-identities.json, agents[].capacityProviderId -> ops/registry/capacity.json providers (plan, price, quota policy live there, not here). Metadata only: no tokens, no addresses. Anything not read from a primary source is verified.level=unverified.

tosVerdicts.allowed: The vendor documents this route for this use (primary source cited in tos.basis).
tosVerdicts.allowed-by-design: We assign tasks through the agent's own interface or our own protocol the way the product is meant to be used; vendor terms were not read for automated use.
tosVerdicts.conditional: Permitted only under the stated condition; Summer must satisfy it before dispatch.
tosVerdicts.restricted: Driving it works but may breach consumer terms (UI automation of a consumer app). Do not add new dependence; move to a supported route.
tosVerdicts.forbidden: Terms forbid this server automation. Never dispatch.
tosVerdicts.unverified: No terms were read. Treated as not dispatchable until a verdict is recorded.

workloads.label: Dogfood the golden path
workloads.mission: Walk signup, claim and first value on the Launch project's certified path with the canary accounts; report every dead end, console error, wrong copy or layout shift with exact repro steps and a screenshot reference.

workloads.label: QA sweep beyond the tests
workloads.mission: Exploratory QA of the most recently merged user-facing changes on staging; find bugs the test suite misses and report repro steps.

workloads.label: Independent PR review
workloads.mission: Review the named open pull requests read-only for correctness, security and regressions. Return a verdict and findings per PR with file and line. Do not push, comment or merge.

workloads.label: Prospect research and outreach drafts
workloads.mission: Find qualified prospects for the Launch project's ICP, with source links, and write DRAFT outreach per prospect. Drafts only: nothing is sent, posted or messaged to a real person.

workloads.label: Backlog dedupe and reorder proposals
workloads.mission: Read the agent-ready backlog; propose duplicate sets, stale items to close and a re-ordering by value per hour. Proposals only: no issue is changed.

workloads.label: Research brief
workloads.mission: Answer the named question with sources and a recommendation. Use the research router; do not call paid search providers directly.

workloads.label: Strategy review
workloads.mission: Challenge the current Launch plan against YC activation-first doctrine; return the three highest-leverage changes with evidence.

agents.label: Instinct

route.note: Tim 2026-10-28: Instinct is reachable on Slack and iMessage, not the mesh. Slack is preferred. Not wired: the only Slack bot token found on this Mac (the retired Hermes-era demo_app bot in the Slack workspace) has scopes assistant:write, channels:read, groups:read, mpim:read, im:read, chat:write, channels:join. It cannot look up Instinct (no users:read), open a DM (no im:write) or read a reply (no im:history/channels:history), and it is another runtime's credential, so Summer does not use it.
needs: A Slack app owned by Summer with bot scopes users:read, im:write, chat:write and im:history (or channels:history for a shared channel), installed in the workspace; its bot token in Summer's Vercel env.
Instinct's Slack user id, or the channel Instinct reads.

agents.capabilitySource: Tim, 2026-10-28 (prospect finding, outreach drafts, dogfooding, finding bugs tests miss; could review every PR)

limits.note: No usage cap on its own model (Tim 2026-10-25). Delegating to Codex draws the shared Codex pool.

box.notes: Own Linux box with CLI installs, deterministic 24/7 code, its own IP, Exa and Firecrawl access (Tim, 2026-10-28; not independently observed).

tos.basis: Tasks would go out through Slack, Instinct's own interface, once a Summer-owned Slack app exists; no consumer subscription CLI is driven. Not wired yet, so nothing is dispatched. Vendor terms not read.

verified.evidence: Slack and iMessage reachability is from Tim via the coordinator; no message sent, no reply observed.

routesAlt.note: Summer's Photon lane is the founder-private thread. Agent traffic does not go through it. Needs a separate iMessage identity for Summer-to-agent traffic, which does not exist.

route.note: Proven 2026-10-28 through Summer dispatch and result code with an in-memory mesh and the real `hyperagent execute` (thread cmvss736w02ze07add3p1t5mb, 63s). Not live: no bridge consumer is registered or polling, so status stays pending-bridge and Summer will not dispatch.

agents.capabilitySource: skills/hyperagent/SKILL.md and the capacity registry (many models on credits).

limits.note: Spend the credits before they expire; pace by balance over days left (capacity registry). `hyperagent models --json` lists only GLM 5.3 Flash, GLM 5.3 and astra: Opus 5.5 is not selectable (2026-10-28).

cost.note: Founding 500, $200/year; credits given, not bought, expire 2027-06-01.

verified.evidence: Hyperagent thread cmvsrrv2v02zh07ade7dk7584 (UI PR review) and cmvss736w02ze07add3p1t5mb (execute wrapper via dispatch/record code).

agents.label: Cursor (Ultra, CLI)

route.executor: A bridge on the Mac polls the ops-mac-host mailbox and runs `cursor-agent -p --trust --mode ask --model auto "<prompt>"` in a scratch directory (read-only), replying by mesh with the FLT ref. Never pass --force or drop --mode ask for reviews and research.
route.note: Proven 2026-10-28 through Summer dispatch and result code with an in-memory mesh and the real cursor-agent (PR review of two PRs, 243s, found real defects). Not live: no bridge is registered or polling. Cursor Origin cloud agents and automations are an unverified second route.

agents.capabilitySource: Tim/coordinator 2026-10-28 and one observed task.

limits.note: Subscription Tier reports Ultra (`cursor-agent about`, 2026-10-28), but the default model returned "You're out of usage. Switch to Auto"; only `--model auto` works. That is an exhausted included-usage pool on the logged-in account, so Auto is the only available capacity. The login is an Apple private-relay address, so it may not be the company Ultra account. Reset date and remaining quota are not readable from the CLI.

cost.note: Cursor Ultra per Tim; price not recorded.

box.notes: Origin cloud agents run in Cursor-hosted environments; per-agent machine access not recorded.

tos.basis: The CLI documents --print for scripts and non-interactive use and Cursor markets background/cloud agents for dispatch; Cursor terms were not read, so no allowed verdict yet.

verified.evidence: cursor-agent logged in; `--model auto` answers; one real PR-review task ran through Summer dispatch/record code in 243s (4 busy minutes in the ledger).
